Choose urn U with prior probability 4/7, otherwise urn V. U has 14 red and 6 blue balls; V has 7 red and 10 blue balls. Draw 6 balls uniformly without replacement from the chosen urn and observe exactly 3 red and 3 blue, with order unobserved. What is the posterior probability that U was chosen? Give an exact fraction.

Give an exact fraction.
